# TSBS DevOps — Disk IOPS - 1 Hour

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Disk read/write operations per host

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  hostname,
  device,
  SUM(reads_completed) AS total_reads,
  SUM(writes_completed) AS total_writes
FROM disk
WHERE
  time >= '2024-01-02 09:00:00' AND time < '2024-01-02 10:00:00'
GROUP BY
  hostname,
  device
ORDER BY
  total_writes DESC
```
